captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a compact, low-profile corner clamp designed for holding a glass bed. It features a rounded corner base that transitions into a right-angled triangular bracket. A central vertical hole passes through the cylindrical corner, featuring a wider countersunk recess at the top to accommodate a screw head.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric glass bed corner clamp in OpenSCAD with an adjustable overall height, outer corner radius, and screw hole dimensions. The part should combine a cylindrical mounting hub with a triangular bracket, featuring a recessed inner triangular cutout for the glass clearance and a countersunk screw hole.
captions.factory: The script constructs the clamp using a boolean difference operation. The main body is created by unioning a vertical cylinder (acting as the rounded corner) and a triangular prism defined via the polyhedron module. From this combined shape, the script subtracts a smaller inner triangular polyhedron to form the recess, a central through-cylinder for the screw shaft, and a wider concentric cylinder at the top for the countersunk screw head.
